pr3.title: v0.5.5: connected compressor capacity control and measured training
pr3.body:
Live plant gains opt-in single-compressor manual/automatic suction capacity control. Delivered speed drives the conservative refrigerant model; requested speed, sensed/actual suction, targets, limiting reasons and timers remain separate from playback. Legacy manual runs, banks, saved profile schemas and Fahrenheit/psig defaults are preserved.

Ordinary run demand now honors minimum-run timing, while master disable and independent model stops inhibit immediately. Accepted start/rest/demand-stop deadlines include fractional times with linked history evidence. The workspace exposes controls, synchronized curves, SI exports, reset/pending-mode guidance and stop-first range-edit instructions.

Three measured Default lessons cover managed startup, minimum-run demand hold and automatic suction-target response alongside the five preserved legacy lessons. Settings/basis/permission guards prevent unsupported grading; completion pauses at accepted boundaries and freezes the exported controller/history evidence. Timing lessons label shortened illustrative assumptions.

Validation:
- Local: all 13 numerical and 16 Chromium suites passed.
- Numerical coverage includes conservation, simultaneous feed/suction PI, ten-minute load/mode operation, high/low saturation recovery, fractional deadlines/refinement, trips/clear evidence, atomic edits, batching, all eight lessons, observer purity and frozen reports.
- Browser coverage includes actual UI/model/export agreement, managed lessons at 1×/10×/60×, units, guidance, recovery, tablet/phone touch layouts and offline/older-browser operation.
- Hosted CI passed on `e86da1975dd177248a78d40c114bf76123c173ea`: 13 numerical, 16 Chromium and 7 WebKit suites, plus deterministic source/bundle consistency. [Verify simulator run 37850014665](https://github.com/cdehek/Ammonia-sim/actions/runs/37850014665).
- Review regressions verify immediately returned telemetry for manual→automatic and automatic→manual transitions without added simulation time or physical changes; priority operating reasons and current limits remain correct. Applied-mode guidance reads the actual settings. Endpoint protection uses the accepted interval's delivered speed, covering demand shutdowns, missed/false discharge trips, idle intervals and starts, with legacy physics/work comparisons.
- Fresh Codex review of `e86da1975dd177248a78d40c114bf76123c173ea` completed and reported no major issues ([review result](https://github.com/cdehek/Ammonia-sim/pull/3#issuecomment-6069849244)); all previous review threads are resolved.
- Generalized test report and demonstration checklist: [RELEASE_CHECKS.md](RELEASE_CHECKS.md).

Scope: controller/plant coefficients remain illustrative; manufacturer/measured equipment calibration stays v0.6.0. Managed capacity requires one circulating compressor; external demand is explicit, without connected thermostat/bank sequencing or rotor/oil/defrost modeling. WebKit/iPad emulation does not claim physical-device validation.

Release candidate is 0.5.5. Pages remains at the approved v0.5.0 baseline until approval, merge and deployment.
